status: visual direction approved by Evan in chat; native implementation in progress

ui.style: warm charcoal translucent surfaces, cream text, restrained amber highlights; world dominates
ui.menu_actions: one word; explicit logout; F2 settings; Escape dismisses
ui.rule: Do not add inert buttons or invent quest, inventory, friendship, time, or weather state.

perspectives.identity: One persistent tile and world state, two camera perspectives
perspectives.overland: Navigation-scale composition, readable routes and silhouettes
perspectives.cinematic: Closer lower-angle framing, smooth transitions, preserve selected tile and restore prior overview
perspectives.implemented: V and bottom action buttons; tile fallback framing and nearby POI bounds
perspectives.remaining: Authored entry/approach camera positions and bespoke cinematic interactions per hero tile

asset_tiers.houses: Hero: authored roof tiles, timber joinery, bevels, windows, doors, porch, material separation, near-view geometry
asset_tiers.major_pois: Ultra hero: retain architectural identity, dedicated close LOD, entrance, functional parts, authored lighting, terrain integration
asset_tiers.bunker: Keep 48 door, roof skylights, chimney, piers and secondary entry; do not regenerate a generic substitute
asset_tiers.lod_contract: Retain high-detail masters; derive overland LODs separately. Do not use overland reductions as cinematic masters.
asset_tiers.materials: Restore source normal and roughness/metallic maps with correct linear color space. No upscaled-texture or subdivision claims of restored detail.
asset_tiers.performance: Measure each target platform at representative close and overland views before setting per-tier budgets.

blockers: Full-detail bunker master referenced in handoff is unavailable locally; provided Meshy canvas does not load.
Other high-detail building masters are not present in the supplied release; existing files are reduced generated models.
acceptance: Review each house/POI close-up and overland
Check doors, roofline, materials, scale, pivot, collision and source provenance

Check daylight and night readability without obscuring fog
Validate desktop performance; validate iOS separately
